name: Nikolet Kostur
bio: Nikolet is a PhD student in the London Natural Environment Research Council (NERC) program, based at King's College London, the London Zoo, and affiliated with the University of Miami. Originally from the Pacific Northwest, she earned her B.Sc. in Biology from Davidson College in 2021. Before starting her PhD, Nikolet spent three years working in the emerging field of Bio-Design, where she founded the Royal College of Art's first biology research space. Currently, Nikolet researches marine communities, termed "epifauna," that inhabit coastal defense structures, such as seawalls and breakwaters. Wahoo Bay is her primary research site, where she collects data to study how these marine communities compare between conventional vs. eco-coastal SEAHIVEs.Nikolet’s PhD aims to improve our understanding of these rarely studied systems, to inform coastal structure designs that better support resilient marine life in urban areas.
